Package Name: AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows
Cisco Secure Client Software for Windows
Method of Attack: Arbitrary File Delete vulnerability allowing privilege escalation to SYSTEM account
Abusing Windows installer process function to escalate privileges
Exploitation via vpndownloader.exe creating and deleting files in c:\windows\temp directory
Privilege escalation through client update process executed after VPN connection
Impacted Systems: Cisco Secure Client Software for Windows
AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows
Attack Vector: Authenticated threat actors exploiting Windows installer process function
VPN client update process after successful VPN connection
Arbitrary file deletion by SYSTEM account via vpndownloader.exe
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published by Filip Dragović
